title: skills-sh-jezweb-claude-skills-claude-agent-sdk
summary: # Changelog ## 0.3.332 - Added `tool_result_meta[].rewritten_by_plugin`, set when a mod's `session.append` hook changed a tool result - Added the `PreSkillShellCommand` hook event with its input and output types - Fixed auto mode missing mid-turn user messages where feature flags aren't fetched, as on clouds or with telemetry off, from Opus 4.8 on. They count as the user's: mark other text `isSynthetic: true` - Changed `Query.setPermissionMode()` to resolve with `{ mode }`, the mode now in effect, or `undefined`; code that holds its promise as `Promise<void>` no longer compiles - Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.332 ## 0.3.331 - Added `sideload_flags_disabled` to `startup_failure_reason`, for a start that managed `disableSideloadFlags` refuses over a flag or launch option - Added `processing_at` to `getCcrEvent()`, and fixed browser SDK `sse` queries dropping the server's queued notices
type: skills
tags: skills-sh, skills-sh-all-time
source_url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/claude-agent-sdk-typescript/main/CHANGELOG.md
